title: Base-change mate for explicit affine spectrum coefficients
statement: Let $f:X\to S,f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime,g:S\prime\to S,g\prime:X\prime\to X$ form a cartesian square of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme] and fix a pullback proof for the square of their spectrum maps $f_0,f_0\prime,g_0,g_0\prime$. For $K\in D(\mathcal O_X),K\prime\in D(\mathcal O_{X\prime})$ and $\phi:L(g\prime)^*K\to K\prime$ [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback], construct $K_0,K_0\prime,\phi_0$ by [def-pc-affine-spectrum-derived-coordinates]. Let $t:S\prime\to\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(S\prime,\mathcal O_{S\prime})$ be canonical. There exist $e_L:Lg^*Rf_*K\cong Lt^*Lg_0^*Rf_{0*}K_0$ and $e_R:Rf\prime_*K\prime\cong Lt^*Rf_{0*}\prime K_0\prime$ with $\mathrm{BC}(K);Rf\prime_*(\phi)=e_L;Lt^*(\mathrm{BC}_0(K_0);Rf_{0*}\prime(\phi_0));e_R^{-1}$, for the canonical comparison [def-pc-derived-base-change-map, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. No quasi-coherence, stalk condition, flatness or boundedness is assumed. No invertibility of the base-change map is asserted.

theorem affineSpectrumCoordinates_comparison
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X'] [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    (sq0 : IsPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
      (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map g.appTop))
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') :
    let K0 := affineSpectrumDerivedObject X K
    let K0' := affineSpectrumDerivedObject X' K'
    let φ0 := affineSpectrumDerivedMorphism g' K K' φ
    ∃ (eL : (derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj K) ≅
        (derivedPullback S'.toSpecΓ).obj
          ((derivedPullback (Spec.map g.appTop)).obj
            ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map f.appTop)).obj K0)))
      (eR : (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').obj K' ≅
        (derivedPullback S'.toSpecΓ).obj
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map f'.appTop)).obj K0')),
      schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w K ≫
          (schemeDerivedDirectImage f').map φ =
        eL.hom ≫ (derivedPullback S'.toSpecΓ).map
          (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap
              (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
              (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) sq0.w K0 ≫
            (schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map f'.appTop)).map φ0) ≫ eR.inv
